majorVersion.description: Major version used for build-version defaults and new releases.

uvVersion.description: Pinned uv version used to resolve and install the Python workspace in CI.

pythonVersion.description: Python major.minor version used by workspace CI jobs.

cppVersion.description: C++ version to use for building the project.

defaultBuildType.description: Default build type to use use for building the project.

eosImageRepository.description: EOS image repository to use in CI.

eosImageTag.description: EOS image tag to use in CI.

ctaImageRegistry.description: CTA image registry to use in CI.

dCacheImageRepository.description: dCache image repository to use in CI.

dCacheImageTag.description: dCache image tag to use in CI.

defaultPlatform.description: Default platform to use for the development environment and build.

packageGroups.description: Defines custom package groups. Each key can be referenced in the versionlock or buildRequires below, causing the corresponding version information to be applied to all packages in the package group.

platforms.description: Defines the information of how to build the project for a given platform.

versionlock.description: Exact package versions for platform-specific dependency installation.

runRequires.description: These values are used to generate KEY_VERSION_CONSTRAINT cmake variables. Every key will be converted to uppercase, special characters converted to underscores and _VERSION_CONSTRAINT will be appended.

buildRequires.description: Build dependencies used for RPM BuildRequires or Debian Build-Depends.
